[[Category:Cherry Fork Cemetery, Cherry Fork, Ohio]]
== Biography ==
Mary was born in 1791. She passed away in 1809. 
=== Parentage ===

David Faris's dedicated genealogy of [[Glasgow-12|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Barclay-56|Rosanna Barclay]] identifies '''Mary Rhoda Glasgow''' among their ten children. This family reconstruction agrees with the migration and sibling evidence summarized on Robert's profile, so both parent relationships are treated as confident.

== Research Notes ==

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-12]] is assessed at 78% (probable). Mary Rhoda’s 1791 Rockbridge birth fits Robert/Rosanna’s Virginia family and the Faris genealogy cited on her profile. The supplied dossier lacks the book’s actual parent passage.

Named child to the specific adult family role represented by the selected father; independent earlier ancestry is outside this assessment.
